2608.16285.title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
2608.16285.paper_summary: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.
2608.16285.paper_summary_zh: 音視覺分割（AVS）是多模態感知中的一個基本任務，通過利用視覺和音頻線索對視頻中的聲音物體進行像素級分割。它在視頻理解、人機互動和自動駕駛等方面有廣泛的應用。然而，大多數現有的AVS方法並未明確建模幾何線索，如相對距離和遮擋，從而限制了跨模態對齊的穩健性。在人類感知中，空間結構自然與音視覺證據整合，以準確定位聲音物體。受到此啟發，我們將估計的深度作為AVS的空間結構線索，並提出DGCM-AVS，一個共同建模音頻、視覺和深度信息的三模態框架。具體而言，我們設計了一個深度感知動態調製器，以改善相鄰物體的分離，同時保持物體內部特徵的一致性。此外，我們提出了深度引導的漸進融合，利用深度作為中介橋樑，逐步將音頻線索與視覺特徵對齊。與最先進的方法相比，DGCM-AVS在AVSS數據集上實現了M_J相對提高10.2％和M_F相對提高8.7％。我們相信，我們的研究突顯了深度作為一種有前景但尚未充分探索的AVS模態，並可能鼓勵在這個方向上的進一步研究。
